title: ISO 17359:2018 — Condition monitoring and diagnostics of machines — General guidelines
version: Edition 3, 2018-01; ISO catalogue last reviewed and confirmed 2023; accessed 2026-11-25.
locator: Official catalogue abstract and lifecycle status; general procedures for establishing a machine condition-monitoring programme.
notes: Official catalogue confirms published edition 3 and current status after 2023 review. Used only as a general programme-planning reference; it does not define CNC machine-specific monitoring intervals, alarm thresholds, acceptance limits or root causes.
